title: The three application tiers
caption: The application server uses the Kafka feed and writes to Oracle

nodes.label: Web user
nodes.description: Someone using the web app. Exact role and task are open.

nodes.label: Web app
nodes.description: Receives user input; hosting style and user operations are open.

nodes.label: Application server
nodes.description: Handles web requests, consumes Kafka events and persists records.

nodes.label: Kafka
nodes.description: Carries events consumed by the application. A separate upstream eventing service is an open question.

nodes.label: Application datastore
nodes.description: One logical application datastore hosted by Oracle RAC. Schema and operational ownership are open.

relationships.label: Consumes events from
relationships.description: A client dependency. Event records flow the other way.
